risks.title: Sensibilite aux taux d interet (REIT et cout du capital)
risks.score_rationale: "interest rates on our cost of capital. We also believe that participating in other investment" (debut Item 1A, 6%). REIT sensible aux taux mais Realty Income bilan investment grade; langage materiel. Note revisee de 5 a 4.
risks.summary: Hausses taux compriment cap rates et cout de financement.

risks.title: Risque locataire et concentration sectorielle (retail)
risks.score_rationale: "tenant properties are counted separately in the table above. Geographic Diversification The following table sets" (milieu Item 1A, 34%). 15000+ properties triple-net, diversification substantielle par locataire; langage prudentiel. Note revisee de 4 a 3.
risks.summary: Defaillances locataires cles (Walgreens, Dollar Tree, 7-Eleven) affectent revenus.

risks.title: Disruption du retail physique par l e-commerce
risks.score_rationale: "Retail Investment Focus Retail properties represent a significant portion of our portfolio. Within this category" (debut Item 1A, 1%). Realty Income cible retail resilient (grocery, convenience, dollar stores); risque limite. Note revisee de 4 a 2.
risks.summary: Retail selectionne resilient face au e-commerce (necessity-based).

risks.title: Integration acquisitions et execution M&A
risks.score_rationale: "acquisition volume in 2025. We believe that our large U.K. and European net lease real" (debut Item 1A, 3%). Spirit Realty et VEREIT digerees; risque integration standard pour REIT actif. Note revisee de 3 a 2.
risks.summary: Deals a taille (Spirit 9.3Md, VEREIT) exigent execution operationnelle.

risks.title: Expansion internationale (UK, Europe) et risques geographiques
risks.score_rationale: "International expansion has also enhanced our flexibility and optionality, allowing us to dynamically allocate capital" (debut Item 1A, 3%). Croissance UK/Europe volumetriquement plus faible que US, langage prudentiel. Note revisee de 3 a 2.
risks.summary: Portefeuille UK/EU croissant expose Realty a cycles locaux et change.

ai_positioning_fr.summary_fr: La société ne mentionne pas l'intelligence artificielle dans son rapport. Il n'y a aucune mention significative de l'IA ou du machine learning.

ai_positioning.summary: Realty Income (REIT triple-net lease retail/industriel) n'a pas de stratégie IA matérielle. Le portefeuille est diversifié sur ~15 600 propriétés louées à des locataires tiers (7-Eleven, Dollar General, Walgreens, etc.). Usage IA limité à des outils internes de gestion immobilière et d'analyse de crédit locataire.
evidence: No material AI disclosure in O 10-K 2024
Internal analytics for tenant credit underwriting (standard tools)
Indirect exposure: data center REIT competitors (DLR, EQIX) benefit from AI, not Realty Income
